display_title: An Idol Is Obsessed With Me
description:
*“What if a harmless, big-dog-like idol turned into a predatory, obsessive guy?”*

Haruna is a perfectionist office worker who has always lived her life on a set path. When she runs into Seo Ha-Ru, a top Korean idol fleeing a stalker, she mistakes him for just another “good-looking bar employee”!

 *“You're the first woman who hasn't recognized me.”*

A series of mishaps begins with this ridiculous misunderstanding. She thought it was over, but then their phones get swapped, and he even moves in next door?!

On stage, he’s a genius superstar who captivates the whole world. But in front of me, he’s a harmless puppy of a younger man who follows me around like a shadow. 

However, when another man starts hanging around Haruna, the gentle giant’s gaze begins to change...

The harmless younger man’s dark transformation—the unleashed predator’s relentless obsession begins!

(Source: Naver Series, translated)
